prompt:
Generate one high-quality cinematic 16:9 image for the specified section, not a generic slide or dashboard. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Do not invent a completed publication, a live security test, a solved outing, approval or consensus. Fictional editorial staging, not documentary evidence. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
VISUAL FORMAT: claim-depth-exploded-view
TEACHING PURPOSE: Separate tool response, resulting state and required human outcome.
CAMERA: Oblique exploded editorial still life with three depth planes.
Three unmarked translucent glass planes float in a controlled editorial studio composition, stepping from LOWER LEFT foreground to UPPER RIGHT background, with wide gaps and visible depth. Beneath them a tiny ivory architectural room model rests at far bottom right. Pearl gray and smoky teal, precise soft shadows, bright enough to read black typography. Each plane is blank and uncluttered for exact independent overlay labels. No connecting arrows, text, numbers, icons, data or people. A conceptual separation of claims, never evidence of a real booking.
COMPOSITING INTENT: Three offset semantic planes reveal response, venue record and unmet result. The viewer must travel through the depth instead of reading three identical cards.
SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: FICTIONAL TOOL + STATE FIXTURE. For an agent evaluator, separate three claims. The tool returned success. The reservation exists in the venue record. The required result is a usable outing, with attendance conflicts resolved or explicitly accepted by the coordinator. The first two facts do not establish the third.
